Displayed on the brand's dress-form mannequin, which looks exactly like this: a female dress form with a slim, defined shape, a rounded bust, a narrow waist and softly curved hips. The torso is covered in smooth matte black stretch fabric with a very soft satin sheen. It has no head and no face. In their place is a short black fabric-covered neck topped by a round, polished dark walnut-brown wooden neck cap and a tall, slim turned wooden finial in the same polished dark walnut, tapering upward like an elegant knob. Two slim arms in glossy black lacquer are attached at the shoulders and hang straight down, slightly away from the body, with a thin silver joint line at each wrist, ending in glossy black sculpted hands with relaxed, slightly curved fingers. Below the torso it has two full-length slim legs in the same glossy black lacquer as the arms, standing straight with the feet close together and ending in glossy black sculpted feet. It stands directly on the floor with no pole, tripod or stand visible. It looks like a high-end atelier display form, not a standard white or generic retail mannequin. The abaya is dressed neatly on it, with no pins, clips or tags visible.

Full-length front view of the mannequin wearing the abaya, centred, straight-on. Seamless soft sand-beige studio backdrop, warm soft light, a gentle shadow on the floor. Vertical 4:5 image.
